snippet.title: Find Your Words - Official Release Window Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Find your community at summer camp, one friendship at a time. Take a beat, enjoy a breath of fresh air - all while playing at the beach, strolling in the woods, and dancing with friends. This short cozy game was created by two dads, celebrating their kids’ journeys to find their voices. Find Your Words will be available on PC in April 2026.
